title: Announcing CreativeMode for Bedrock: Make Addons without Coding
summary: CreativeMode for Bedrock: make Minecraft Bedrock addons for mobs and items, no coding needed. Just describe your idea, and CreativeMode makes it real.
body_markdown:
## What Is CreativeMode?


[CreativeMode](https://creativemode.net/) is a tool that turns your written ideas into real Minecraft addons. Simply describe what you want, like “a lava-proof flying pig that drops gold when defeated” or “a magical pickaxe that breaks blocks in a 3x3 area”, and CreativeMode handles the rest. Within minutes, you get a downloadable mod file that just works.


## Now for Bedrock, Too


Previously available for Java Edition, CreativeMode now extends the same effortless power to **Minecraft Bedrock Edition** . This means players on Windows, mobile, and console can now enjoy custom content made with the same simple interface.


Just type your idea. No command blocks, no scripting, no learning JSON, just creativity.


## Create Custom Mobs and Items Without Code


With Bedrock support, we’re also rolling out **generation for both Mobs and Items** :


### 🐾 Custom Mobs


You can now create entirely new creatures: bosses, pets, monsters, animals, and more. Give them unique textures, behaviors, sounds, and drops, all by describing them in plain English.


Want a “creeper that teleports behind players and drains health”? Done. A “friendly bee that gives you speed when you feed it a flower”? Easy.


### 🧱 Custom Items


From tools to food to weapons, you can now generate new items with special effects. Define what they look like, how they behave, and what they do, all without writing a single line of code.


Want a “grappling hook that launches you forward when right-clicked”? You got it. “Ice cream that makes you run faster”? Sure.


## How It Works


**Describe your idea** – Be as specific or creative as you want.


**Let CreativeMode process it** – Our AI turns it into a real addon.


**Download and install** – You get a .mcaddon that works instantly in Bedrock.


It’s that simple.


## Try It Today


Whether you're new to modding or a seasoned creator looking to speed things up, now is the perfect time to try it out.


👉 **Start building your own Bedrock Mobs and Items now at[creativemode.net](https://creativemode.net/)**
